notes: 25 Sept 2026: Athletic reported 114 of 115. 29 Sept: the Premier League published a redacted Core Decision (about 40 pages; appendices to follow) and a statement; the commission found City in breach on every charge bar one (Charge 4(B)) including a 'Disguised Funding Scheme' overstating income by more than £830m (revenue inflated and costs reduced by more than £900m per the statement). Status tag is now 'FOUND (published decision)'. 1 Oct (7pm): City lodged an appeal; independent three-member Appeal Board; hearing expected within 12 weeks, decision within 30 days of the hearing ending; hearing private until outcome publication is permitted. Sanction to be decided at a separate hearing; no date found (the Premier League wants it concluded as soon as possible). Banner clock end (24 Dec 2026) is computed as 1 Oct + 84 days. Premier League and decision-PDF pages could not be opened from the research environment; details are from several outlets and a Mishcon de Reya summary.
appeal_detail: City lodged an appeal against the commission's findings on 1 October 2026 (per the club and the Premier League, as reported). An independent three-member Appeal Board will hear it; the hearing is expected within 12 weeks and stays private until publication of the outcome is permitted. Sanction is still to be decided at a separate hearing.
